title: Coles profit hit by underpayment scandal
excerpt: Coles chief executive Leah Weckert said it had been another consistent set of results for the supermarket that had been through multiple court proceedings.
body:
Sydney Morning Herald published this story this week. Headline: Coles profit hit by underpayment scandal.

We pulled the headline and summary so you can decide whether it's worth reading in full. The original article is linked at the top of this brief.
